programme.title: Private Eyes - In the Arms of Morpheus
programme.desc: During her recovery from an injury, Angie hears someone threatened from her hospital room while under the influence of a drug; no one believes her. - Jason Priestley, Cindy Sampson, Jordyn Negri (Drama, Series)

programme.title: Private Eyes - School's Out for Murder
programme.desc: At Angie's high school reunion, she drags Shade along so she doesn't have to confront her ex-BFF, Jada Berry, alone; after a body ends up on the dance floor, it's up to the PE crew to solve the mysterious murder. - Jason Priestley, Cindy Sampson, Jordyn Negri (Drama, Series)

programme.title: Family Law - Until Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Abigail and Daniel represent Ira, who wants his wife Helen moved from a care home that he claims is worsening her Alzheimer's; because his daughter doesn't want Helen moved and holds power of attorney, Ira must challenge her in court. - Jewel Staite, Victor Garber, Brett Kelly (Comedy, Drama, Law, Series)

programme.title: Family Law - Baby Off Board
programme.desc: The lawyers are bewildered when a young couple begs them to reverse an adoption after learning about the baby's serious health issues; Abigail determines that the father is driving the decision, and convinces the mother to fight to keep the baby. - Jewel Staite, Victor Garber, Brett Kelly (Comedy, Drama, Law, Series)

programme.title: Weeds - Viking Pride
programme.desc: Nancy is visited by faces from the past; Silas deals with the possibility that Lars is his father; Warren becomes unhinged; Doug must obtain a fake passport. - Mary-Louise Parker, Elizabeth Perkins, Kevin Nealon (Adventure, Comedy, Crime, Drama, Entertainment)

programme.title: Weeds - Fran Tarkenton

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Living in exile on the planet Vulcan, the ragtag former crew of the USS Enterprise steal a starship after receiving a planetary distress call from Earth: a space probe has entered into orbit around Earth, disabled global power on the planet and evaporated the oceans. Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Catherine Hicks, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. - Haley Joel Osment, Jude Law, Frances O'Connor, Brendan Gleeson, Sam Robards (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Bran Nue Dae
programme.desc: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey. - Rocky McKenzie, Jessica Mauboy, Ernie Dingo, Geoffrey Rush, Magda Szubanski (Drama, Comedy, Musical)

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: This animated comedy finds Tommy Pickles (E.G. Daily) trying to return his baby brother to the hospital after being warned by his mean-spirited friend, Angelica (Cheryl Chase), that once his new sibling is born his parents won't care about him. But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all. - E.G. Daily (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick. - Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger, Mary-Louise Parker, David Strathairn, Joan Plowright (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Drama, Action)

programme.title: Love Means Zero
programme.desc: Tennis coach Nick Bollettieri's relentless desire to win at all costs leads to the destruction of an important relationship. (Documentary)

programme.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown. - Kelly Kruger, Brendan Penny, Tom Arnold, Lisa Hartman, Tina Simmons (Comedy)

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Members (Andre Gower, Robby Kiger) of a monster fan club meet Count Dracula, Wolfman, Frankenstein, the Mummy and Gill Man. - Andre Gower, Robby Kiger, Stephen Macht, Duncan Regehr, Tom Noonan (Horror, Adventure)

programme.title: View From the Top
programme.desc: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Christina Applegate, Mark Ruffalo, Candice Bergen, Joshua Malina (Comedy, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Monster Summer
programme.desc: A mysterious force disrupts Noah and his friends' summer fun. They team up with a retired police detective to embark on a monstrous adventure to save their island. - Mel Gibson, Lorraine Bracco, Mason Thames, Kevin James, Nora Zehetner (Adventure, Horror)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. - Patrick Swayze, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Joseph Mazzello, Seth Mumy, David Marshall Grant (Fantasy)

programme.title: Our Ghosts
programme.desc: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. - Michele Riondino, Hadas Yaron, Paolo Pierobon, Orlando Forte, Alessandro Haber (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Smoke Signals
programme.desc: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. - Adam Beach, Evan Adams, Irene Bedard, Gary Farmer, Tantoo Cardinal (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement. (Documentary, Music)

programme.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
programme.desc: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom. - Charlie Carter, Sarah Lawn, Jo Price, Matthew Wolf (Documentary)

programme.title: Nancy Drew
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Nancy Drew (Emma Roberts) accompanies her father (Tate Donovan) on a business trip to Los Angeles and stumbles across evidence in the case of a movie star's long-unsolved death. The young heroine's resourcefulness and integrity are put to the test in the glamorous -- but sometimes treacherous -- world of Hollywood. - Emma Roberts, Josh Flitter, Max Thieriot, Rachael Leigh Cook, Tate Donovan (Children, Mystery, Adventure)

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: In the 23rd century, the Starship Enterprise is dispatched to the scene of a giant energy field about to engulf two ships. Capt. Kirk (William Shatner) averts calamity, but is exposed to the field and presumed dead. Years later, the Enterprise's new commander, Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart), learns that one of the disaster's survivors, Dr. Soran (Malcolm McDowell), plans to enter the field by destroying a neighboring star. Picard now must collaborate with an unlikely ally in order to stop him. - Patrick Stewart, William Shatner, Malcolm McDowell, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
programme.desc: In the long-running animated series' second feature film, the focus is on the show's perennial second banana, Chuckie (Christine Cavanaugh). Dads Stu (Jack Riley) and Chaz (Michael Bell) are unexpectedly sent to Euro-Reptarland in Paris, where the animatronic dinosaurs they built for the amusement park are malfunctioning, much to the displeasure of manager Coco La Bouche (Susan Sarandon). When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Free Birds
programme.desc: Pardoned by the president, a lucky turkey (Owen Wilson) named Reggie gets to live a carefree lifestyle, until fellow fowl Jake (Woody Harrelson) recruits him for a history-changing mission. Jake and Reggie travel back in time to the year 1621, just before the first Thanksgiving. The plan: Prevent all turkeys from ever becoming holiday dinners. Unfortunately, the two birds encounter colonist Myles Standish (Colm Meaney), out to capture feathered friends for all the hungry Pilgrims. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Now that Dracula has opened the Hotel Transylvania's doors to humans, things are changing for the better; however, Drac is secretly worried that his half-human grandson, Dennis, isn't showing his vampire side. So, while Mavis and Johnny are away, Drac enlists his friends to help him put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp. But things really get batty when Drac's cantankerous, old-school dad pays an unexpected visit. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Wolf Kahler, Ronald Lacey (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: Capt. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart) team up to thwart mad Dr. Soran's (Malcolm McDowell) quest for the Nexus of joy.

programme.title: Show Dogs
programme.desc: A hot tip leads a canine cop and an FBI agent to Las Vegas to recover a stolen baby panda. Working undercover at a dog show, the crime-fighting duo must now foil another kidnapping plot and rescue other valuable animals from a gang of smugglers.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: A shy man (Lance Bass) scours the streets of Chicago in search of a vivacious woman (Emmanuelle Chriqui) he met on a train.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: FBI - Reticence (New)
programme.desc: S9E4 - The team investigates a missing infant and a string of murders as it all connects to a rocket propulsion company on the verge of going public. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: CIA - Black Tie Optional (New)
programme.desc: S2E4 - When a prominent investor begins selling highly sensitive information to Korean agents, the team must go deep undercover at a high-end gala event to prevent a deadly invasion; Bill struggles with troubling discoveries of his father's past. - Tom Ellis, Nick Gehlfuss, Necar Zadegan, Natalee Linez (Crime drama)

programme.title: Harlan Coben's Final Twist - Caught on Camera (New)
programme.desc: S2E5 - When a young couple is found shot dead in a crashed car in Nashville, detectives dig through phone records and blurry security footage that lead them across state lines straight into a secret someone was willing to kill to protect. (Crime)

programme.title: CBS LA at 11pm (New)
programme.desc: Join the CBS LA team for stories from communities around SoCal, breaking news from The Desk, and NEXT Weather from the Weathersphere. (News)

programme.title: Comics Unleashed With Byron Allen (New)

In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. programme.title: Peppa Pig - America; The Diner; Canyon Country; Hollywood; Hop, Skip, Jump!
programme.desc: Peppa and family win a trip to America; Peppa and family take an RV across America; the family visits Hollywood; Peppa and her friends play games in the garden. - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Jungle Penguins; Pups Save a Freighter
programme.desc: S6E1 - When an ice floe carrying three penguins lands in the jungle, the pups must get the birds back to their frosty home; Daring Danny is locked out of the lighthouse Turbot left him to look after, with a freighter headed his way. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save an Extreme Lunch; Pups Save a Cat Burglar
programme.desc: S5E5 - Daring Danny X is harnessed over a canyon eating an extreme lunch when the wind blows him upside down; during Pie Swap Day in Adventure Bay, Humdinger sends Rocky Kitty to take one of Mr. Porter's pies so he can join the contest. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Kitty Rescue Crew; Pups Save an Ostrich
programme.desc: S5E1 - Mayor Humdinger creates fake emergencies for his kitties so they can appear better than the PAW Patrol; the Wingnuts get a new pet ostrich, but it gets lost on the trip home. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Director; Pups Save the Super Cows
programme.desc: S11E5 - Francois is directing a video when his camera crane rolls away; all the farm animals go missing from the Super Farm Fair. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Space Kitty; Pups Save the Sea Sponges
programme.desc: S11E26 - When Humdinger puts on a cat costume, the Alien Kid mistakes him for a real kitty in need of a home and beams Humdinger into his UFO; after a tiring deep-sea dive, Zuma dozes off and dreams about the life he might have. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Butterflies; Pups Save an Underground Chicken
programme.desc: S5E7 - Chickaletta is stuck on a runaway drone and mysterious butterflies cause chaos all around Adventure Bay; Mayor Humdinger steals the statue of Chickaletta. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Get Growing; Pups Save a Space Toy
programme.desc: S3E19 - When Yumi's crops begin to sprout huge vegetables, the PAW Patrol must corral the stampeding produce; the pups draw a message for space aliens on Farmer Al's field. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a City Kitty; Pups Save a Cloud Surfer
programme.desc: S4E18 - Cali gets lost in the woods; Daring Danny X's harness becomes loose while kite-surfing; he must fix it before he gets hurt. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Mega Stunt Ramp; The Crew Builds a Solar Farm
programme.desc: S3E9 - The crew uses their trucks to make stunt ramps when Mega Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition; when power problems shut down Sierra Sparkle's show, the pups hop in their big vehicles to turn the power back on. - Leslie Adlam, Jonathan Tan, Shazdeh Kapadia, Sabrina Jalees, Martin Roach (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Parking Garage; The Crew Builds a Campsite
programme.desc: S1E25 - Café Carl's new ice cream machine brings lots of cars to Builder Cove; Rubble's fear of the dark derails the pup's Bark Yard campout. - Luxton Handspiker, Leslie Adlam (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups in a Jam; Pups Save a Windsurfing Pig
programme.desc: S3E18 - All the fruit at the annual Jamboree Jamfest is carried off by ants; Zuma goes on a wacky water rescue after Cornelius the pig goes for a ride on a windsurfing board. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Manatee; Pups Save Breakfast
programme.desc: S6E10 - Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi need help from the PAW Patrol to get a manatee to the swamp; Mr. Porter and Alex get into a sticky situation involving maple syrup. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Blimp; Pups Save a Chili Cook-Off
programme.desc: S4E1 - Cap'n Turbot's weather blimp is taken by Mayor Humdinger, who plans to use it to change the weather in Foggy Bottom; Mr. Porter's stove explodes right before the chili cook-off. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Mighty Pups vs. the Big Chill; Mighty Pups vs. the Mighty Cheetah
programme.desc: S10E16 - Harold creates a ray that can freeze things instantly, it goes awry and sends a giant ice ball toward Adventure Bay; the Cheetah snatches half of Chase's Meteor Crystal, Chase must stop the Cheetah and restore his crystal. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups vs. Ouchy Paws; Pups Save a Glow-in-the-Dark Party
programme.desc: S8E14 - Sid Swashbuckle pretends to be a legendary ghost so that he can take Danny's new skateboard; Ryder and the Pups race to save Mayor Goodway's Glow-in-the-Dark Party. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Sniffle; Pups and the Ghost Cabin
programme.desc: S2E17 - Just as the PAW Patrol is about to help Farmer Al capture his runaway pigs, Chase, Zuma and Skye all become sick; when lunches start disappearing at an old miner's cabin in the woods, the PAW Patrol comes to investigate. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Spring Chicken Is Coming
programme.desc: S1E13 - The Bubble Guppies must grow a flower for the Spring Chicken. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Trick-or-Treat, Mr. Grumpfish!
programme.desc: S4E14 - The Guppies choose their Halloween costumes, go trick-or-treating and turn their classroom into a haunted house in hopes of scaring Mr. Grumpfish. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Lonely Rhino
programme.desc: S2E3 - The Guppies learn about the zoo while trying to find a friend for a lonely rhinoceros. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Have a Cow!
programme.desc: S1E15 - The Bubble Guppies learn about farm animals. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - A Big Splash!
programme.desc: S6E9 - On the Shimmy-Shimmy Islands, everyone's preparing for Queen Zooli's dance party, but each time they practice, a huge wave splashes them. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Bubble Medics to the Rescue!
programme.desc: S6E15 - In Ancient Greece, paramedics Zooli and Gil get a call for help from Nonny, so they fly toward him in their chariot ambulance; on the way, they're pursued by a Cyclops. - Catherine Bradley, Caleb Clark, Leah Janvier, AJ Kane, Nirvaan Pal (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Oyster Bunny!
programme.desc: S3E12 - The Guppies must follow an egg trail to find the mysterious Oyster Bunny. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Batterball!
programme.desc: S4E5 - Molly and Gil see how bubble-cakes are made when they step into Chef Stef's kitchen; the Guppies get their turn when they take the field to play batterbal; it'll take teamwork to run the kitchen-station bases and bake a treat! (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Sizzling Scampinis!
programme.desc: S2E12 - The Bubble Brothers Circus is coming to town, and all the Guppies are getting into the act: Goby the clown, Gil the acrobat, and Oona the lion tamer. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Bubble Kitty!
programme.desc: S3E24 - When Molly and Gil find a lost kitten named Bubble Kitty, they help take the cat home to Meownt Rushmore. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Swinging in the Rainforest!
programme.desc: S5E18 - City-slicker umbrella sellers Molly and Gil set up shop in the Amazon rainforest. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Summer Camp Games!
programme.desc: S4E13 - Molly, Gil and the Guppies celebrate summer with lots of outdoor fun; Gil uses his camping skills to rescue Bubble Puppy during the Summer Camp Games. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Fishketball!
programme.desc: S1E10 - The Guppies prepare for a game of fishketball by practicing bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - A Tooth on the Looth!
programme.desc: S2E8 - Deema has a loose tooth; the Guppies learn about keeping a healthy smile. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Owl; The Apple Tree; The Big Hill; The Bug Hotel; Grandpa Pig's Greenhouse
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig builds a special bird watching hut; Peppa and family enjoy their garden apple tree all year round; Grandpa Pig shows Peppa and George his special 'Bug Hotel'; Grandpa Pig and Grandpa Dog show their greenhouses to Peppa and George. - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Long Grass; Dentist; Nature Trail; Rebecca Rabbit; School Bus Trip
programme.desc: The grass grows very long; Peppa and George go to the dentist; the family drives to the countryside; Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house; Peppa and her friends go on a bus trip. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Stone Age Granny; Space Adventure!; Fire Station Practice; Science Museum; Mr. Bull the Teacher
programme.desc: Granny and her friends' historical reenactment society are being cave people today; Peppa and George are reenacting the Apollo moon landing. - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Hearing Test; Favorite Sound; Hospital Sleepover; Caring for Grandpa Pig; Granny Sheep Moves In
programme.desc: During a hearing test, Peppa and her family find out George needs a hearing aid; now that George can hear much better with his new hearing aid, Peppa makes it her mission to show him her favorite sounds! - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide
programme.desc: S14E3 - The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom; the Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Skye's Road Trip Rescue
programme.desc: S11E25 - Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Stadium Dome; The Crew Builds a Baggage Claim
programme.desc: S5E1 - When Speed Meister rains on the Builder Cove Sing-Off, Rubble and Crew saves the show by building a giant dome over the stadium; Rubble and crew build an elaborate baggage claim system at the airport when nobody can find their bags after flying home. - Leslie Adlam, Jonathan Tan, Shazdeh Kapadia, Sabrina Jalees, Martin Roach (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Katie's Arctic Road Trip; Pups Save a Magical Mishap
programme.desc: S12E12 - Skye, Everest, Liberty and Katie go on a camping adventure where they encounter a polar bear with a sweet tooth; when Julia and Julius put on a magic show, they are convinced they accidentally turned Mr. Carter into a rabbit. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Deer Squad - Dojobot; A Shark's Life (New)
programme.desc: S4E4 - Baron Bite steals Kai's training Dojobot and turns it against the squad; Lady Fluffpot believes she sees a sea monster while swimming at the beach. - Brody Allen, Connor Andrade, Juliet Rusche, Holden Thomas (Animated, Children, Animals, Entertainment)

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines - Royal Rescue
programme.desc: S4E16 - A visit to the King's castle goes awry when the King accidentally catapults himself far, far away; to bring him home, Blaze, AJ, and the King's adorable pet dragon, Zeek, must transform into knights in shining armor. (Animated, Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Educational)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Hum-Sprayer; Pups Save the Hot Springs
programme.desc: S12E13 - Mayor Humdinger makes a mess when he steals paint from Rubble's cousin Mix; two mountain goats cause trouble at adventure bay's hot springs. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Air Rescue: Pups Save the Mother Tree; Pups Save the Ice Cream Truck

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Halloween Maze; The Crew Builds a Giant Pup House
programme.desc: S4E1 - The crew builds a spooky maze for Halloween; when Omar and Romar get lost in the maze, the pups jump to the rescue; when a spooky movie keeps Rubble awake, the pups come up with a construction solution. - Leslie Adlam, Jonathan Tan, Shazdeh Kapadia, Sabrina Jalees, Martin Roach (Animated, Children, Holiday, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Dino Chicken

programme.desc: S1E8 - Amber and Jon are looking for a getaway near their home in Raleigh, N.C., and Lake Gaston fits the bill.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Family Affair on the Southern Tier
programme.desc: S4E6 - A New Jersey couple seeks to fulfill a lifelong dream of purchasing a home near their families in New York's Southern Tier; they hope to find an outdated cottage they can renovate into a cozy escape where their young family can enjoy lake life.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Alabama Lakefront Overhaul
programme.desc: S1E13 - A couple with renovation know-how is looking for a fixer-upper lake house near Weiss Lake in Alabama, and find a place with hidden problems in the walls and under the floor.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Vacation Home Search on Scenic Lake Barkley, Kentucky
programme.desc: S6E11 - A couple expecting their first child together look for a vacation home on Kentucky's beautiful Lake Barkley. They want to do their own renovations, but they must be done before mom has to go back to work once the baby is born.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Longtime Friends Give a Lake House New Life in South Carolina
programme.desc: S5E10 - A decades long friendship explores uncharted waters when an agent helps her longtime friend buy and renovate a lake home; they've made countless memories on Lake Hartwell, so it's only fitting that's where he's looking to find his forever home.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - From LA to Lake Tuscaloosa
programme.desc: S3E5 - A couple hopes to escape their busy LA lives with a quiet vacation home along Lake Tuscaloosa; they find a property with great potential and are ready to take on the renovations, but it may prove to be more work than expected.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Vermont Stone House
programme.desc: S9E4 - Novice builder Danny Clark attempts to construct a 600-square-foot stone cabin in Vermont's White River Valley; the home is sure to be a true work of art, but his inexperience, the harsh winter and the unusual architecture push him to his limits.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Container Dreamhouse
programme.desc: S8E4 - First-time builders Shay and Shae set out to build a home using five shipping containers on a wooded lot in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Island Getaway
programme.desc: S9E2 - A family attempts to build a 400-square-foot cabin situated on a small island in Northern Idaho; access to the property is limited, and rough waters make it difficult to bring materials in; it's a race to the finish as winter hits the island early.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Streamside Cottage
programme.desc: S8E5 - Professional tree-house builder Michael "Murph" Murphy wants to build a cottage retreat for his family in Washington; he enlists his friends to create natural siding and a massive fishing net for lounging above the living space.

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Network Presents - Junior
programme.desc: Stars and legends from across the sports and entertainment landscape discuss Ken Griffey Jr.'s generational talent, which transcended baseball and made him one of sports' most famous athletes. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Network Presents - The Swingin' A's
programme.desc: Examines the tense relationship that existed between controversial owner Charlie Finley and the A's roster of superstars that won three World Series titles from 1972-74. programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning. - Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh, Natasha Lyonne, Paul Hipp, Anita Pallenberg (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. - Eric Roberts, Liam James Collins, Dallas Hart, Jonathan Peacy, Arthur Sylense (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
programme.desc: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard. - Darryl Stephens, Jensen Atwood, Gary LeRoi Gray, Rodney Chester, Christian Vincent (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. - Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement, Josh Wiggins, Forrest Goodluck, Khloe Janel (Comedy)

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule. - Brendan Fraser, Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell, Randall Batinkoff, Andrew Lowery (Drama)

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. - Tsemaye Bob-Egbe, Natey Jones, Jo Wheatley, Alexandra Burke, Michael Junior Onafowokan (Drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. - Elias Koteas, Briana Middleton, Bridget Wareham, Justin Nurse, Reuben Frederick Gear (Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: All the World Is Sleeping
programme.desc: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter. - Melissa Barrera, Jackie Cruz, Kristen Gutoskie, Luis Bordonada, Lisandra Tena (Drama)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. - Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey, D.J. Cotrona, Rick Cramer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Spontaneous
programme.desc: When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last. As an unexpected romance blossoms between them, they soon discover that when tomorrow is no longer promised, they can finally start living for today. - Katherine Langford, Charlie Plummer, Yvonne Orji, Hayley Law, Rob Huebel (Dark comedy, Horror, Romance)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. - Garrett Hedlund, Hamish Linklater, Brittany Snow, Christian Convery, Tramell Tillman (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another. - Fionn O'Shea, Robert Aramayo, Erin Kellyman, Louis Hofmann, Jodi Balfour (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. - Channing Tatum, Alex Pettyfer, Matthew McConaughey, Cody Horn, Olivia Munn (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. - Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, Vince Vaughn, Jeremy Piven, Ellen Pompeo (Comedy)

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Kevin (Lance Bass) has everything going for him, but his lifelong lack of confidence keeps him from recognizing love and happiness -- even if it's sitting next to him. When Kevin meets the girl of his dreams, Abbey, on Chicago's L train, they connect immediately, but he lets this golden opportunity slip away by not having the courage to ask her for her name and number. Unable to find her, or forget her, Kevin and his buddies launch a massive campaign to locate Abbey. - Lance Bass, Joey Fatone, Emmanuelle Chriqui, GQ, James Bulliard (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Tzi Ma, Ken Leung (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Roselyn Sánchez (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Hiroyuki Sanada, Yûki Kudô, Max Von Sydow (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend. - Rico Verhoeven, Frank Grillo, Roland Møller, Rona-Lee Shim'on, Kevin Janssens (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love. - Alex Pettyfer, Vanessa Hudgens, Neil Patrick Harris, Peter Krause, LisaGay Hamilton (Fantasy, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath. - Daniel Radcliffe, Misha Handley, Roger Allam, Ciarán Hinds, Janet McTeer (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known. - Dakota Fanning, Kathryn Hunter, Mary McCormack, Rachel Blanchard, Devyn Nekoda (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

programme.title: Office Christmas Party
programme.desc: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: When an inmate is granted one weekend of freedom to see her dying mother, a rookie correction officer struggles to keep her under control.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as the Coast Guard launches a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.desc: Arturo Bandini is a writer who moves from Colorado to Los Angeles with aspirations of completing a great novel. There he meets bold Mexican waitress Camilla. She wants to live a better life and thinks marrying for money may be her answer. Arturo, who tries to project a confidence that he is inwardly lacking, initially acts coldly toward Camilla. Despite not seeming like a viable match, a romance gradually develops between the two. - Colin Farrell, Salma Hayek, Donald Sutherland, Idina Menzel, William Mapother (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. - Elizabeth Banks, Emily Browning, Arielle Kebbel, David Strathairn, Jesse Moss (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. - Dustin Hoffman, Laurence Olivier, Roy Scheider, William Devane, Marthe Keller (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard (War, Historical drama, Action)

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done. - Danny Trejo, Michelle Rodriguez, Sofía Vergara, Amber Heard, Antonio Banderas (Action)

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy. - Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, David Wenham, Dominic West, Rodrigo Santoro (Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, War)

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. - Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman, Holly Hunter, Ed Harris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Cho Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. - Kate Hallett, Herman Tømmeraas, Aya Furukawa, Justin Chatwin, Steven Ogg (Thriller)

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. - Jasmin Savoy Brown, Lili Simmons, James Jagger, Tessa Munro, Dana L. Wilson (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: Following a strange sexual encounter, a teenager (Maika Monroe) has disturbing visions and the inescapable feeling that someone -- or something -- is stalking her.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: Family and friends try to save a Hispanic teen who appears to be possessed by malevolent supernatural forces.

programme.title: Crimes of the Future
programme.desc: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs.

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: A lieutenant colonel and approximately 400 U.S. troops battle 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers in 1965.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When dictator Joseph Stalin dies, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Stranded on Earth, aliens Beldar and Prymaat of Remulak try suburbia with their teenage daughter, Connie.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Tracy faces no competition in her high school election, but the civics teacher intervenes by encouraging the varsity football player to run for president, resulting in chaos.

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. - Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek, Ted Levine (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protégé (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score. - Pierce Brosnan, Luke Bracey, Olga Kurylenko, Bill Smitrovich, Will Patton (Action, Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley, Max von Sydow, Michelle Williams (Thriller, Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: Twenty years after Maria Rossi (Suzan Crowley) murdered three people, her daughter, Isabella (Fernanda Andrade), seeks the truth about that terrible night. Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. With the help of two young exorcists (Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth), Isabella tries to cure Maria -- and engages four demons in a battle for her mother's soul. - Fernanda Andrade, Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth, Suzan Crowley, Ionut Grama (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system. - Tim Allen, Sigourney Weaver, Alan Rickman, Tony Shalhoub, Sam Rockwell (Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. - Bailey Chase, Neal McDonough, Dawn Olivieri, Kearran Giovanni, Olivia Sanabia (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: I Was a Stranger
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries. - Omar Sy, Jay Abdo, Mahmood Bakri, Saleh Bakri, Ziad Bakri (Drama)

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler. - Elisabeth Harnois, Morgan Kelly, Kimberly-Sue Murray, Thomas Mitchell, Victoria Sanchez (Thriller)

programme.title: Vindicta
programme.desc: When a city is terrorized by a sadistic serial killer, a seasoned detective and a newly recruited paramedic are forced into a deadly game of vengeance, only to discover the key to stopping the bloodshed lies in unlocking the truth of their own pasts. - Elena Kampouris, Jeremy Piven, Sean Astin, Travis Nelson, Bradley Stryker (Thriller)

programme.title: Area 51
programme.desc: Obsessed with UFOs, a man (Reid Warner) and two friends find evidence of an alien presence at Area 51 in Nevada. - Reid Warner, Ben Rovner, Jelena Nik, Roy Abramsohn, Darrin Bragg (Science fiction, Horror, Mystery)

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors. - Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea, John Hurt, Rupert Graves (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done. - Danny Trejo, Michelle Rodriguez, Sofía Vergara, Amber Heard, Antonio Banderas (Action)

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. - Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. - Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, Karen Gillan, Rhys Darby (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: What could possibly go wrong when three buddies (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) decide to join the Boy Scouts? When bloodthirsty, undead ghouls invade their once-peaceful town, it's up to kindhearted Ben, quick-witted Carter and class clown Augie to save the day. With help from Denise (Sarah Dumont), a beautiful but tough cocktail waitress, the boys must put their scouting skills to the ultimate test to save mankind and earn their zombie-killing badges. - Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan, Sarah Dumont, David Koechner (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven (Brandon Lee) and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent inner-city gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the gothic mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger. Tracking down the thugs responsible for the crimes and mercilessly murdering them, Eric eventually confronts head gangster Top Dollar (Michael Wincott) to complete his macabre mission. - Brandon Lee, Ernie Hudson, Michael Wincott, David Patrick Kelly, Angel David (Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. - Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat, Brian Boland, Molly Ephraim, Sprague Grayden (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. - Dylan O'Brien, Jessica Henwick, Dan Ewing, Michael Rooker, Ariana Greenblatt (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: The Enterprise and its crew follow a Borg ship through a time warp to prevent the Borg from taking over the Earth in a past era. Stuck in the past, Geordi La Forge helps a pioneer of space travel in his efforts to create the first warp drive while Capt. Picard and Cmdr. Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. - Aaron Eckhart, Hilary Swank, Delroy Lindo, Stanley Tucci, D.J. Qualls (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. - Jordana Brewster, Clea DuVall, Laura Harris, Josh Hartnett, Shawn Hatosy (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Este Haim, Elizabeth Berkley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. - Shanti Lowry, Sophia Ali, Andrew Howard, Omar Gooding, Dylan Mooney (Thriller)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Colin Farrell (Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: After a shady investor steals their new invention, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) conspire to kidnap the man's adult son and ransom him to pay off their debts.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.desc: When Ryan learns that he's been diagnosed with a rare, fatal illness his best friend Seth has other plans for him as he talks him into maxing out his credit cards and doing everything he's ever wanted to do from his Bucket List.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: A hardworking man's inability to say no to a beautiful woman gets him in trouble when he agrees to steal $68,000.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Investigating three faceless corpses, a detective (Bruno Campos) considers a teacher (Alix Koromzay) at an inner-city high school the prime suspect.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Unable to remember the horrific events of her past, Nell Sweetzer tries to rebuild her life in New Orleans. However, a demonic force soon returns with sinister plans for her.

programme.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
programme.desc: An Irish engineer (Val Kilmer) and a U.S. hunter (Michael Douglas) stalk two lions decimating a construction crew in East Africa.

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society.

programme.title: Spell
programme.desc: After surviving a plane crash in rural Appalachia, a man tries to break free from a woman's dark magic and save his family from a sinister ritual before the rise of the blood moon.

It is an unnerving thought that unaccountable, unseen forces are actively steering our lives, potentially for the worse. (Documentary, Paranormal)
